== Summary ==
The same group outside at the [[2009 World Championship]], October 2009, unlabelled (posted as "shannonbusey.jpg"). It is a joke edit of [[:File:2009 World Championship group outside 2.jpg]]: actor Gary Busey's face is pasted over [[Kevin Shannon]]'s. The others are [[Jerry Heine]], [[Thomas McGee]], [[Brian Fred]], [[Chris Schoenthal]] and [[Dan Kim]] (maroon T-shirt, arms crossed, centre front). See [[:File:2009 World Championship labeled group photo.jpg]] for the labelled version.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by BrenDerlin: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=484120#p484120 post 484120], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 18 November 2009. Photobucket album brenderlin_photo, image shannonbusey.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123061451/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/b/b7/2009_World_Championship_group_outside.jpg Internet Archive].
